articles.summary: Learning generalizable robot manipulation policies requires large-scale and diverse demonstration data. articles.summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a standard paradigm for post-training large language models (LLMs). articles.summary: Memory-augmented VLM agents act on persistent spatial knowledge, yet that knowledge silently goes stale as the environment changes. articles.summary: Chart question answering (CQA) requires multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to integrate visual comprehension with logical reasoning, yet current models struggle with accurate visual grounding and coherent reasoning chains. articles.summary: Viscous stains, characterized by high viscosity and complex rheological properties, remain a major challenge for robotic surface cleaning.
